structured_output.what_is_happening: "Stupid Inu" (SI) is a pump.fun coin created and migrated to PumpSwap within 18 seconds (created 1790352816, migrated 1790352834). That almost always means a bundled or coordinated buy filled the bonding curve at launch. Its only social link is a WatcherGuru tweet, so it is a news-reaction meme. At least 7 other "Stupid Inu"/SI coins were launched in the hour before it, and they are now all dead or near-dead ($0–$11k liquidity). This one won the copycat race. It hit an ATH of about $404k market cap and now sits at about $139k, roughly 65% below the peak. It is still up 133–178% over the hour, with $246k of volume against $33k of liquidity (7.5x turnover). The last 5 minutes are choppy: DexScreener shows +20%, GeckoTerminal shows -17%, and buys and sells are even at about 175 each. The dev has fully exited (creator_close, balance 0), and the coin is flagged as a community takeover.
